frame.grid.note: 64x64 luminance grid. Recorded for provenance, NOT used as a gate: llvmpipe is not bit-reproducible across runs, so the frame is compared with the MEASURED tolerance and byte-hashing it would make the gate flake on renderer noise. THE ASYMMETRY IS DELIBERATE.

state.json.note: the deterministic dump, BYTE-HASHED. This is the INDEPENDENT WITNESS: a comparison of the golden against a copy of itself moves BOTH sides when the golden is edited, so a one-quantised-unit perturbation is invisible to it. Provenance is a separate file the mutant does not touch (bead oo-gxp).

frame_control.control_method: the IDENTICAL scenario - same staging, same seed, same ticks, same dump - run with a DIFFERENT checklist save (ThargoidPlans.oolite-save) and with NO -load at all, so the ONLY variable is which commander state was loaded.
frame_control.tolerance_source: tests/golden/frame_hash.py derive_tolerance() over tests/golden/calibration.json (bead oo-ae9; noise floor 0.002541, weakest real signal 0.007541). USED AS MEASURED, never adjusted.
frame_control.verdict: two launches of the same scenario differ by 0.001534 (0.35x the tolerance) while loading a different checklist save moves the frame 0.017065 (3.90x) and a fresh game 0.062845 (14.36x). An 11-fold noise-to-signal separation against the nearest control arm.

landing_rehearsal.note: both the scenario script and the gate lines search goldens/windows-x64/013-constrictor/ FIRST and fall back to tests/golden/pending/013-constrictor/ through the IDENTICAL idiom, so landing is a pure `git mv` with no code change. See LANDING.md.

mission_state_differential.verdict: 7 of 8 mission-state fields move against the ThargoidPlans arm and 6 of 8 against a fresh game. mission_conhunt itself does NOT move against the fresh arm (both absent), which is exactly why live_mission_handlers is required alongside it; the checker REJECTS both control dumps with rc=1.

note: Scenario 013 (bead oo-5h8e): upstream/oolite-tests/Checklist-files/Missions/Constrictor.oolite-save - a 1.75-era checklist save - is loaded via the game's own -load argument, the game runs 24 ticks of game time in Esgebi (system ID 240, galaxy 1) under seed 20260918, and the dump carries mission_variables BOTH at top level and inside evidence. MEASURED FINDING: this fixture is PRE-mission - mission_conhunt is ABSENT because oolite-constrictor-hunt-mission.js sets conhunt only when player.score > 255 and this commander's ship_kills is exactly 255. Absence alone is a weak assertion, so it is paired with the BEHAVIOURAL consequence: the mission script still has all three event handlers live, which a MISSION_COMPLETE save (deleted in _cleanUp()) and a fresh game (script never built) both lack. provenance.scenario_knobs records the determinism knobs this golden was BLESSED with, and the acceptance gate asserts spec.json still agrees with them, so re-blessing with a new seed stays legal while silent drift between spec and golden is fatal.
